result.summary: Several visual and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a broken discount badge showing '-0%', and horizontal clipping on category chips and cards that make the UI look unfinished.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on detail; ensure card width accommodates typical names.

issues.description: Pizza card shows a nonsensical '-0%' badge, which looks like a broken or missing discount value.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when discount is 0/null, or show a valid promo (e.g. '10% off'); never render '-0%'.

issues.description: Category filter chips and 'Fastest near you' cards are clipped at the right edge with no clear fade or peek of the next item.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding and a partial next-item peek or fade so scrollable rows don’t look cut off.

issues.description: Bottom popular card (pizza) is partially cut off by the tab bar, so content feels incomplete on first view.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so cards clear the tab bar, or ensure scroll position leaves a clear edge.

issues.description: Delivery fee text uses a very light gray that may be hard to read and looks washed out next to bold titles.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text for better contrast and visual hierarchy.
